# Marketing Research: A Technical and Academic Treatment

> A technical and academic treatment of marketing research by Mike Nguyen: constructs, substantive domains, and the methods that connect them, with reproducible code throughout. Written for doctoral researchers and senior technical practitioners; constructs are defined formally, methods are stated with their estimators and identification assumptions, and every cited work carries a DOI. The online edition is at https://mike-marketing-research.share.connect.posit.cloud/.

- Author: Mike Nguyen, https://mikenguyen.netlify.app
- Repository: https://github.com/mikenguyen13/marketing_research

## Research Methods Library (MCP server)

- [MCP endpoint](https://research-methods-mcp.vercel.app/mcp): Model Context Protocol server (streamable HTTP, no authentication) that indexes this book together with the author's other books, the causalverse R package, and research articles. Its tools recommend study designs with their identifying assumptions (`choose_method`), search and read sections (`search`, `fetch`), return runnable R and Python code (`get_code`), and format citations (`cite`); every result links to the section consulted.
- [Research Methods Library](https://research-methods-mcp.vercel.app/): setup instructions for Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, Visual Studio Code, and other MCP clients.
